variables: See-through tint that sets an area one step apart from whatever it sits on: the page, a card, a panel. Neutral1000 at 6% in light (a step darker), Neutral0 at 6% in dark (a step lighter). Use it for a panel inside a panel, a table stripe or inline code, on neutral surfaces only (it dulls brand and status fills). Put it on one layer only: tints add up when nested. Text on it is checked against the darkest surface it can sit on. Fields keep surface-field.
Hover on an area tinted with surface-alpha. Neutral1000 at 10% in light, Neutral0 at 10% in dark. One layer only, as surface-alpha.

Border of an unchecked checkbox or radio box, at rest and on hover. Meets 3:1 against the page in both modes, since the box is the only mark of the control. Checked boxes use Control/checked-*; disabled ones Border/border-subtle.
